unexpectedPreexistingRule.candidateTargets: all 14 recovery endpoint/schema targets from deployment queue
unexpectedPreexistingRule.action: Capture every candidate that appears in fresh projectPaths before any write.
unexpectedPreexistingRule.batching: Use additional bounded read_files calls; one unexpectedly large endpoint per call is always safe.

requirements: Fresh Floot list_files must run first.
All 16 normal baseline paths must exist in projectPaths.
Every normal batch response must return every requested file in full; omitted files require an additional read before any write.
Any unexpectedly preexisting recovery target must be captured with exact content before any write.
Raw capture must record projectId, projectVersion, productionOrigin, capturedAt, full projectPaths, and captured file contents.
Build and validate the normalized snapshot, then build and commit the rollback plan before the first Floot write.
